product_metadata.title: PEIDUO Christmas Jeweled Crown Tree Topper Adapter Plug in with 60 Warm White Lights LED Light Up Tree Topper Decoration for Christmas Tree
features: 【CROWN TREE TOP】 Exquisite and unique crown shape is 9.5*7.75 inch size, a shiny big diamond, 144 transparent beads, 60 warm white LEDs, 118" lead in.

【ORIGINAL DESIGN】 Crown tree topper made of Iron and 60 fairy string lights. In addition, the design of the spiral bottom is convenient to fix on the tree top, making your Christmas tree more gorgeous and elegant.

【FAIRY LIGHT EFFECT】 Warm white light, with 8 modes of effects such as constant light, flicker and waveform, which is convenient for you to choose freely and adds infinite childlike interest to Christmas.

【PERFECT CHOICE】 It is strong enough and easy to install, and it is not necessary to store it after the festival. The luminous crown highlights its queen temperament and is suitable for any item decoration.

【DAILY & HOLIDAY DECOR】 An exquisite decor to your home, living room, bedroom, fireplace, and children's room. Light up for your Christmas, Valentines, Easter, Birthday, Wedding, Party, and other important events in life.
